description: This file implements a request handler for an HTTP server in a TR-069 host interface project. It manages parameter retrieval and updates, validation against a data model, RFC interactions, and communication with host interface APIs. The code handles GET and SET requests, processes wildcard parameters, and maintains data integrity and authorization checks.

classes.name: res_struct
classes.description: Structure for response data including parameters, statuses, and request type.

classes.name: req_struct
classes.description: Structure representing incoming requests, including parameter lists and request types.

classes.name: param_t
classes.description: Structure representing individual parameters with name, value, and type.
